title: A chat model for Roblox projects
summary:
A Roblox-focused chat model joined the lineup, while image fallbacks and routing got some attention.

Added `roblox-rp`, a filtered chat model with guidance for Roblox development, Lua, and roleplay.

Expanded dating and NSFW prompt detection, revised referral messages, and added redirect routing with analytics.

Restored Cloudflare SDXL as the fallback when Cloudflare Flux image generation fails, before trying ComfyUI. Added tunnel restart configuration and text API diagnostics.

daily.title: Chat for Roblox projects
daily.text: Use `roblox-rp` for Roblox development, Lua, and roleplay with a filtered chat model. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=roblox-rp).
